title: MongoDB Schema Design and Data Modeling
learning_outcomes: Explain the major concepts in mongodb schema design and data modeling.
Apply representative patterns from lessons 99–110 to a synthetic MongoDB scenario.
Verify expected behavior, security boundaries and version/deployment assumptions.
